what_it_establishes: Direction and magnitude of mapped PV area relative to the building-footprint denominator for each city or rooftop segment
what_it_does_not_establish: Installed capacity, electricity contribution, usable-roof saturation or the cause of a city or sector gap
additional_evidence_needed: Harmonized capacity records, usable-roof estimates, installation dates and sector-specific project histories

observed_quantity: Prevalence, roof selection and conditional intensity
what_it_establishes: Exact algebraic composition of utilization and the observed contribution of each building-level dimension to a pairwise gap
what_it_does_not_establish: Why the components differ, whether they are independent or the causal effect of any building, market or policy attribute
additional_evidence_needed: Roof geometry and suitability, system design, ownership and tenancy, installer and financing records, and longitudinal building-level installations

what_it_establishes: Whether mapped PV is broadly distributed or concentrated, including median-grid ordering, zero-PV cells and highest-utilization-cell shares
what_it_does_not_establish: Neighborhood mechanisms, household or firm responses, or results independent of grid definition
additional_evidence_needed: Neighborhood covariates, local land use and network conditions, repeated spatial observations and designs that address sorting and confounding

observed_quantity: Standardized IRR, NPV and one-factor matching scenarios
what_it_establishes: Technology-specific return comparisons under common assumptions and the arithmetic input value that matches a paired baseline scenario when other inputs are fixed
what_it_does_not_establish: Observed project returns, sector-specific finance, an intervention requirement, or the causal deployment effect of changing one input
additional_evidence_needed: Project costs, financing, taxes, load profiles, storage, incentive receipt, installation timing and observed responses to tariff or support changes

what_it_establishes: Transparent ordinal comparison of written revenue and administrative rules under a common codebook
what_it_does_not_establish: Implementation quality, queue time, enforcement, customer experience, policy supportiveness or a causal policy effect
additional_evidence_needed: Application and interconnection records, processing times, fees, rejection reasons, installer and applicant evidence, and policy changes observed over time

observed_quantity: Income ordering, solar-resource proximity and border adjacency
what_it_establishes: Descriptive socioeconomic ordering, regional resource similarity and geographic context for the mapped cases
what_it_does_not_establish: A harmonized individual-income exposure, balance on observed or unobserved factors, outcome-independent sampling or population-level generalizability
additional_evidence_needed: Harmonized microdata, a documented prospective sampling frame, more cases, repeated outcomes and credible comparison or quasi-experimental designs
